doc.title: Hal Galper interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 27, 2022

title: Closing thanks and sign-off
summary: Rowe and Galper thank each other, and Galper asks about the YouTube posting.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Wow, well Mr. Galper, this is more than I had hoped for.
Well you have a unique outlook and — musically and from a philosophy standpoint and I really appreciate you sharing it.
I’m not afraid to give my stuff away.
I’m glad to be part of the —
It’s my stuff and I’m ahead of you on it.
I’ve really enjoyed this. I really enjoyed this, it was really a fun interview, I have to say that.
I’ll sign off and then we’ll say our good-byes.
All right so this will be up on YouTube?
Yeah. In a week or so.
And I’ll take it down and add it to my collection.
